support-cta.looks: A centred, rounded light panel: a large heading, one line under it, one large button with a second line on it, and a line of helper text under the button.
support-cta.use: A single phone or contact call to action, e.g. 'Ready to talk? Call Team HOPE today.'

fields.buttonSubtext: Second line on the button, e.g. the number in digits.
fields.buttonLink: For a phone number use tel:, e.g. tel:18663054673.
fields.helperText: One small line under the button.
